text: Concrete of dynamic foundations: minimum class C35/45 with the exposure requirements of section 10; the minimum reinforcement shall be 0.25 % of the section in each face and direction for massive blocks (thermal cracking control per EN 1992-3 where applicable); thermal control of mass concrete pours shall limit the core-to-surface temperature difference to 20 K and the maximum core temperature to 65 degC (delayed ettringite formation); embedded anchor bolts, sleeves and grout shall be per the OEM installation drawing.
